pose: A wide, stable pure white carbonate float supporting a tall lattice tower with a bright crimson flashing beacon at its apex. A large prehistoric marine turtle (Araripemys) has hauled itself onto the low-profile base, sunning its shell.

environmental_details.ground: Blindingly clear turquoise water flowing over a pure white chalky seafloor with golden sand bars visible in the background.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Intense tropical saturation with a soft hazy glow along the coastal horizon line.
